title: Return to New York and the Feetwarmers
summary: Back in New York, Ladnier and Bechet's band welcomed him at the Savoy, before a career mistake at Small's Paradise.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Chicago here, and so when I finally come back to New York, well Tommy got back before I did, and he and Bashir had formed this band, the New Orleans Feet Warmers, you know. So they greeted me with welcome arms in New York. They were working at the Savoy, and they had six pieces of terrific bands, so they wanted me, and he fit right in. But I made one fatal mistake, which cost me quite a bit of career-wise. I was so anxious and so overjoyed to be back home and to see old friends. There was, at that time, they were having the breakfast dances at Small's Paradise.
